newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi takes delivery of first British Tornado.
newsitem.headline: Saudi takes delivery of first British Tornado.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has taken delivery of the first of 48 Tornado aircraft it had ordered from Britain, the official Saudi Press Agency said on Tuesday.
It said Saudi and British officials, including from British Aerospace Plc which is building the planes, attended the delivery ceremony at an airbase in northern England on Monday.
Saudi Arabia had agreed to buy 48 Tornado aircraft after talks in 1993 between British Prime Minister John Major and King Fahd in Saudi Arabia.
The deal, thought to be Britain's second biggest arms contract, was estimated to be worth about $6 billion.
It formed the second phase of a defence cooperation agreement between Riyadh and London initialled in 1985.
